│  Navigation                                                                                                │
│    1 / 2 / 3 / 4              Show containers / volumes / images / networks                                │
│    j, down / k, up            Move down / up (with count: 5j)                                              │
│    gg, home / G, end          Jump to top / bottom                                                         │
│    ctrl+d / ctrl+u            Half page down / up                                                          │
│    H / M / L                  Top / middle / bottom of screen                                              │
│    zz / zt / zb               Put cursor line at center / top / bottom                                     │
│    ctrl+e / ctrl+y            Scroll view without moving the cursor                                        │
│    space, enter               Expand or collapse compose project                                           │
│                                                                                                            │

│    :s / :S                    Start / stop container                                                       │
│    r                          Restart container                                                            │
